judgments: Checkbox represents an independent or multi-select choice whose effect may be committed later.
Radio is only valid inside a labeled Radio Group and chooses exactly one mutually exclusive option.
Switch changes an immediately applied setting; it is not a decorative Checkbox skin.
Select chooses one option from a bounded list; continuous values and command menus use different components.
Slider adjusts a continuous or stepped range and must expose its value text; it is not used for discrete named options.
Selection/Adjustment owns ic-number-input for precise numeric entry and ic-color-field for UI color adjustment, as explicitly approved at the first human gate.

components.purpose: Choose one independent boolean or one item in a multi-select set.
components.checkmarkEndAppearance: Uses a --ui-palette-gray-50 option surface in light mode and the corresponding gray-800 surface in dark mode, supports optional icon/subtitle/tag content, places a linear checkmark at the inline end, and removes the checkbox box.

components.purpose: Provide one accessible label, value and keyboard scope for mutually exclusive options.
components.tabsAppearance: Horizontal Radio Group variant using the spacing and hover treatment of horizontal-automatic-label Tabs, with a --ui-palette-gray-50 selected surface and corresponding gray-800 dark surface, while retaining radio semantics.

components.purpose: Represent one option inside an ic-radio-group.
Turn an immediately applied setting on or off.
components.trackInset: Horizontal Slider reserves half a Thumb width at both inline edges so the Thumb remains inside the component box at min and max.

components.purpose: Choose one or more values from a bounded list of named options.
components.secondaryAppearance: The collapsed control and selected option use --ui-color-action-secondary-selected with no border; selected and unselected text use --ui-color-text-primary.
components.quietAppearance: Pure-text trigger with transparent background, zero border and zero outer padding; the disclosure icon and keyboard focus ring remain visible.
components.quietMultipleSummary: When one or more options are selected, the collapsed trigger displays their visible labels instead of a generic selected-option count.
components.quietMenu: The popup keeps a readable minimum width and renders each option label on one line, truncating labels only when necessary.

components.purpose: Adjust one continuous or stepped numeric value within a bounded range.
Enter or step one precise numeric value, optionally paired with a Slider by a higher-level field pattern.
Choose and expose one UI color value with a visible swatch and text value.
Choose one or more named project aspect ratios while preserving each ratio's visible shape.
components.multipleEmptySelection: Multiple mode may contain zero selected ratios and never restores defaults after the user clears the final option. A required owner validates on confirmation and presents the required-choice feedback.

runtimeContract.selectOptions: ic-select accepts native option children plus optional start/end adornments and keeps engine option elements private to its Adapter.
runtimeContract.sizeConvention: Selection controls expose small, medium and large sizes; medium preserves the previously approved default presentation.
runtimeContract.numericBoundary: Slider and Number Input accept only finite, ordered and step-aligned min/max/step/value combinations.
runtimeContract.motionOwnership: The public Selection/Adjustment family owns Checkbox and Radio indicator entry, Switch thumb spring movement, and direct-manipulation press feedback. Selected visuals read live :state(checked) and :state(indeterminate), never static checked or indeterminate attributes that only declare initial defaults. Slider position never transitions so Pointer tracking remains immediate. Disabled and invalid controls do not deform; reduced motion uses central 1ms durations and removes press deformation.
runtimeContract.multipleSelectionBoundary: An empty multiple Aspect Ratio Picker is a valid user choice unless the owning confirmation flow marks it required; the picker never auto-restores a previous or default selection.
runtimeContract.engineBoundary: Business and acceptance sources consume only ic-* tags, native option elements and central --ui-* Tokens.
